segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Hey Jordan, quick sanity check on the Northlake add-on. They asked for 18 more seats for the field team, same package as the original 42, and they want it live by March 3.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Yeah, that tracks. Is this the group on annual billing with the June true-up, or are they asking for a separate invoice?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Separate invoice. Procurement said they need a clean PO match for $21,600, net 30, no changes to the main order form.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Okay, easy enough. Just make sure the service start date is March 1 so finance doesn't prorate weirdly for two days.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep. One thing I noticed, their support addendum actually ends this Friday and I don't think anyone has talked to them about carrying that forward, which is, uh, not ideal.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Oof. Yeah. For this add-on, though, keep it scoped to the seats only so we don't slow down the PO.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Agreed. Legal already said the standard seat expansion language is fine, no security review since it's the same workspace.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Good. Send me the final count and the billing contact, and I'll check the pricing sheet before you send it over.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Billing contact is Renee Patel, ap@northlakeindustrial.com. I'll send the draft in five minutes.
